name: Annapolis
summary: Maryland's capital and America's sailing capital — the Naval Academy, the oldest statehouse still in legislative use, and a colonial harbor town.

lodging.name: A historic-district inn near City Dock
lodging.blurb: Walkable to the harbor, the State House, and the Academy.

foodMustTry.name: A crab cake on the dock
foodMustTry.blurb: Jumbo-lump, broiled, minimal filler — order it at the waterfront.

days.label: Day 128 — The Naval Academy & the State House
days.summary: The nation's naval officers and its oldest working capitol.

item.title: U.S. Naval Academy tour
item.blurb: A guided walk through 'the Yard' — the crypt of John Paul Jones, the chapel, and noon formation (photo ID required).

item.title: Maryland State House
item.blurb: The oldest U.S. state capitol in continuous legislative use — and the nation's capitol in 1783–84, where Washington resigned his commission.

days.label: Day 129 — On the Chesapeake
days.summary: Sail the bay and wander the colonial harbor.

item.title: Sail the Chesapeake
item.blurb: A schooner or skipjack sail out of the sailing capital of America.

item.title: Historic district & William Paca House
item.blurb: Georgian streets, a signer's mansion and garden, and the shops around Main Street.

commute.scenicNote: Back across the Bay Bridge and out to the Atlantic coast.
